$Comment: The cooking pit station block. NEVER CRAFTED and deliberately authors no Recipe: building the CookingPit structure pattern creates it - lay a ring of stone-family blocks around an unlit campfire (Deco_Campfire_Off) and the campfire becomes this block; breaking the ring turns it back. Model/texture/hitbox reuse the vanilla unlit campfire so the default look is the campfire the player just placed, and Interactions.Use carries this mod's own rpg_station_use RootInteraction (RPG_Station_CookingPit_Use) rather than any bench auto-open. Five states, one per custody phase the station asset names (Server/RpgStations/Stations/CookingPit.json): Default = unlit and empty; Loaded = unlit with food waiting (raw food on a cold pit does not burn - the floating display prop is the has-food signal); Lit = actively cooking, the burning campfire model with the animated flame, warm light, looping crackle ambient and the flame-plus-smoke particles, all starting and stopping natively on the state flip; Ready = the flame burnt down to glowing embers with cooked food waiting to collect (the lit model and light, no flame particles or crackle); Smoking = the food sat too long and charred, the unlit model under a heavy black smoke plume. The Lit field set is the same vanilla campfire pairing Furniture_Crude_Brazier uses (Campfire.blockymodel + Fire_Burn + Campfire_New_Cartoon at brazier scale). VariantRotation NESW is the station-block placement convention so socket offsets and display props rotate with the block's facing.
